NOVEMBER MASS OF REMEMBRANCE Saturday 28th November 6.30 pm This Mass is for all those Parishioners who died in past year and for those whose funerals took place in our Church. But anyone who is grieving for a loved one is most welcome to attend this Mass of Remembrance. Last Saturday almost 70 of the Ministers of the Word from all the parishes of the partnership came together as a group hosted by Loughlinstown Parish. The morning began with Mass followed by an inform al ‘getting to know you’ sessio n. There was then a sessio n with Saule from the Diocesan Office of Mission and Ministry outlining the importance of the Ministry and giving some practical suggestions for our readers. Everyone who came enjoyed the combination of prayer, chat and learning, and left looking forward to the next meet up.
